# Schedule

> Every member that runs on its own: its card, its wakes on one day, its prompts; how to set a member up on any Claude account.

*Source: <https://sharness.ai/admin/schedule/index.html> · generated by tools/gen_admin.py from content/admin/, so the page and this file cannot drift. Every page on this site has a .md twin.*

---

Every member that runs on its own keeps one card, `content/admin/members/<id>/card.json`: its objective, when it wakes (London time), the model, the session, the repositories to attach, the steps of each wake, what it reads, writes and never does, and two prompts word for word, the start prompt for a new session on any Claude account and the wake prompt for the scheduled task. A card is `proposed` until the editor's go creates the task; every wake leaves a run record, so a missing record is a missed wake. The protocol every wake follows is [WAKE.md](https://github.com/SHarness-AI/SHarness-AI__Website/blob/dev/WAKE.md); the brief is [schedules, cards and start pages](../briefs/2026-10-26__brief__schedules-cards-and-start-pages/index.md). Nothing here is a secret, and nothing here creates a schedule: the editor does, per card, from the member's page. 6 card(s), 0 active, 14 wake(s) a day, as of 26 Oct 2026.

## Setting a member up on any Claude account

1. Open the member's page and read its card: the repositories, the session name, the start prompt, the cron, the wake prompt.
2. On the account, start a session with those repositories attached (push access) and name it as the card says.
3. Paste the start prompt.
4. With the editor's go, create one scheduled task on that account from the card's name, cron and wake prompt, firing into that session; the session makes the card active in its next release.
5. A key the role needs is handed sealed, never pasted: https://pki.sgit.ai/handover.md
